items.prompt:
Exhibition-quality cinematic still for a Japanese kanji ambient gallery.
Keyword theme: one (kanji 一) — interpret through atmosphere, not literal diagram.

Visual Layout v2 concept:
A single ripe persimmon on worn cedar, afternoon amber slicing through paper shoji — solitude before abundance.

Art direction: impressionistic realism with atmospheric storytelling.
Lesson 1 exhibition arc: Opening gallery: from solitary object to shared light — the dawn of seeing.
Reference palette mood: cold blue-grey with pale ivory

Subject type: still_life
Emotional tone: hushed anticipation
Atmosphere: late autumn interior, single shaft of gold
Color: Amber light, soft crimson accents, indigo shadows, restrained greens — atmospheric depth.
Narrative: Frozen moment — contemplative stillness.
Human presence: No human figures in frame.
Camera: Intimate medium or medium-wide — compelling focal subject, room to breathe.

Style references: cinematic still, contemporary landscape painting, Japanese exhibition photography,
atmospheric illustration, visual poetry — NOT clip-art, NOT instructional diagram, NOT stock photo.

Requirements:
- Compelling visual subject that would make someone pause in a gallery
- 16:9 horizontal framing for large-screen / ambient video / coffee-table book
- Favor feeling before explanation; atmosphere over mnemonic symbolism
- No text, labels, captions, diagrams, watermarks, or English words
- No floating kanji or typography pasted over the image
- Kanji 一 only if naturally integrated (carved stone, woven fabric, reflection) — optional, never dominant
- Tactile realism: light, weather, texture, depth
- Beautiful, restrained, memorable

Subject type: human
Emotional tone: steady belonging
Atmosphere: soft snowfall, charcoal coats, amber thermos
Color: Amber light, soft crimson accents, indigo shadows, restrained greens — atmospheric depth.
Narrative: Frozen moment — contemplative stillness.
Human presence: Human subject primary; face clearly visible, natural expression, cinematic portrait quality.
Camera: Medium-wide cinematic — strong subject with atmospheric context.

Style references: cinematic still, contemporary landscape painting, Japanese exhibition photography,
atmospheric illustration, visual poetry — NOT clip-art, NOT instructional diagram, NOT stock photo.

Requirements:
- Compelling visual subject that would make someone pause in a gallery
- 16:9 horizontal framing for large-screen / ambient video / coffee-table book
- Favor feeling before explanation; atmosphere over mnemonic symbolism

- Beautiful, restrained, memorable
